Steps for connecting to Figma remote server:

Install the repo below:
```
git clone -b mcp-auth-workaround https://github.com/connorads/opencode.git opencode-mcp-auth
cd opencode-mcp-auth
bun install
```
Add this to your ~/.config/opencode/opencode.json:
```
{
  "mcp": {
    "figma": {
      "type": "remote",
      "url": "https://mcp.figma.com/mcp",
      "enabled": true
    }
  }
}
```

Go back to the repo you just cloned and run this:
```
bun dev mcp auth your-mcp-server
```

This will open your browser, go to Figma and authenticate your client. Should says something like OpenAI Codex is requesting to authenticate.

In the terminal, it will say that auth is successful. You should be able to use Figma MCP in your client now.
